source_hotspots.note: offlineSpec recognizes spec-only looks; it relies on compoundPlan(text) to decline compound requests before making a spec-only plan.
compoundPlan returns null for W14-11 even though it contains multiple/conflicting paint/material instructions.
offlineSpecAsk applies each parsed spec zone; W14-11 reaches this path with only the matte look extracted and the black/carbon-weave/preserve-color clauses omitted.
offlineAskCore falls through to the compound/edit/looks routes after the compound planner misses W14-11.

limits: No renderer, provider, native application, or browser was run. The real planner, editor compiler, and offline route were invoked; queue handlers are mocks, so route queue output is not a rendered or applied paint.
A safe ask/no queue is recorded as incomplete support, not as successful stack accuracy.
Unknown arbitrary graphic artwork is not considered complete unless the actual queue fully represents every requested action.
